name: Combined absolute layout cache

atomicDiscipline.rule: Run exactly the printed hypothesis. If the attempted change fails, degrades, or suggests a different fix, revert to the checkpoint and finish this experiment as failure. Start a new experiment for the next idea.

hypothesisMarkdown: Combine the snapped absolute bounds and unrounded absolute outer origin stored for each LayoutId into one FxHashMap cache entry. This preserves the existing hashing strategy and recursive lookup behavior while eliminating one hash-table insertion for every newly cached layout node and removing one per-frame table allocation/clear surface.
measurementPlanMarkdown: After beginning the experiment and before editing source, run three independent headed Chromium/WebGPU DataTable benchmark processes at DPR 1 and DPR 2 as the fresh serialized checkpoint distribution. Change only crates/gpux/crates/gpui/src/taffy.rs to combine the two absolute-layout caches, then run three equivalent candidate processes. Compare median acknowledged throughput and paced p95, and require exact warmed Taffy, renderer, traversal, final-scroll, and terminal-error counters. Also run focused and full gpux tests, native and WASM checks, package formatting, and warning-denied Clippy. Accept only if all correctness gates pass, the direct insertion/table reduction is present, and neither DPR materially regresses versus the fresh checkpoint distribution.
expectedOutcomeMarkdown: Preserve exact layout and rendering output while replacing two per-node cache insertions with one. Expect a small improvement or neutral end-to-end result, lower cache bookkeeping, and no new dependency or public API. Renderer, shaders, scene ownership, virtualization, Taffy dependency/version, and computed-root tracking remain unchanged.

gpui formatting passed; 456 tests passed across the package test targets; native checks with rayx_diagnostics disabled/enabled passed; single-thread WASM diagnostic check passed; warning-denied gpui Clippy passed.

Candidate process 1 rejected individual runs at 18.1544 steps/s (DPR 1) and 17.5629 steps/s (DPR 2), so the aggregate candidate JSON was intentionally not produced.

### Decision

Reverted failure. The exact production source was restored to the checkpoint; only durable AgentX experiment metadata remains to commit.
decisionMarkdown: Revert. Although combining the cache records directly removes one hash insertion per uncached layout and one table, the first representative headed browser process violated the benchmark's mandatory throughput gate at both DPRs. The one-attempt contract forbids additional candidate runs or a fix-forward mechanism in this experiment.
notes: The candidate Playwright run emitted an HTML-report/output-folder clash warning because both environment paths resolved beneath tools-node; the tests still executed and failed their independent throughput assertions. Raw candidate output was moved into the approved root artifacts-temp/agentx-experiments tree. No gpux skill or repository memory update was made because the mechanism was rejected.
